newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Treasury redeems CTOs, withdraws BTPs/CCts.
newsitem.headline: Italy Treasury redeems CTOs, withdraws BTPs/CCts.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it was redeeming Treasury Certificates with Options (CTO) with a face value of 4.5 trillion lire and withdrawing fixed rate bonds (BTP) and floating rate certificates (CCT) from the market with a face value of 1.425 trillion lire.
The CTOs, which were issued on November 20, 1990 and fall due this year, were redeemed using 4.443 trillion lire from a special amortisation fund.
Some 1.499 trillion lire was taken from the fund to buy back the BTPs and CCTs.

The Treasury said 17 BTP issues falling due between January 1, 1997 and January 1 2004 were partially withdrawn. Five CCT issues which were due to expire between March 1, 1998 and August 1, 2001 had also been partially withdrawn. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
